meta.title: FEAT-014 — Category tree with attributes
meta.subtitle: Design solution from technical-design.md: the operator loads the category tree and its attributes from a committed file with one command; the load is applied whole or refused whole, and the tree is read one level at a time. Pick a flow to follow one path; click any arrow for its data contract.
meta.description: The operator starts the manual-start Aspire resource catalog-load-categories, which runs the Catalog.Api subcommand load-categories over data/category-tree. The load handler reads and cleans categories.json, attributes.json (each list defined once, with allowsCustomValue) and the link files, takes a Postgres advisory lock, reads the current tree, and asks the pure domain diff for either every problem or a change set. Problems or no change roll back and print a report; a change set is applied in one transaction with a CategoryTreeChanged outbox row, which the running Catalog relays to Service Bus for Search-AI (FEAT-018). Shoppers and sellers read the tree through the gateway: GET /v1/categories returns roots or one parent's children with vi and en names, GET /v1/categories/{id} returns a leaf's effective attributes (its own, else its nearest ancestor's) and their values.
overview: FR-CAT-003, FR-CAT-019, FR-CAT-020, FR-CAT-022 (open lists), FR-CAT-023 (inheritance), FR-LOC-007, FR-CAT-021 (top-level images); supports FR-CAT-004, FR-LOC-008, NFR-LEG-002
UC-020 (main 1–2 for categories, alt 1a), UC-005 (steps 1–2: what the seller picks from), UC-007 (home page category images)
none (operator command); consumed by SCR-SEL-004 (FEAT-012) and SCR-STF-001/002 (FEAT-018)
Catalog.Api load-categories; GET /v1/categories?parentId; GET /v1/categories/{id}; event CategoryTreeChanged/v1

categories (int Id = Tiki key, ParentId, Position, IsLeaf, ImageUrl for top level), attributes (Kind, AllowsMultiple, MaxValues, AllowsCustomValue), attribute_values (Position), category_attributes (Position, IsRequired) — migration SharedAttributeLists (D-11)

nodes.label: Operator
nodes.desc: Prepares the category file (Tiki shape, name: {vi, en}) and runs the load. Reads the report in the resource's console log.

nodes.label: Aspire dashboard
nodes.desc: AppHost project resource on the Catalog image with WithExplicitStart(), args load-categories --source data/category-tree, reference to catalogdb, waits for catalog (migrations). Not in the deployed profile (D-3).

nodes.label: data/category-tree
nodes.desc: Committed operator file, v2 layout (D-13). categories.json (key, parent key, name {vi,en}, imageUrl on top-level categories, array order = sibling order), attributes.json (each attribute once: Dropdown/Checkbox, maxValueCount, allowsCustomValue, values in order) and category-attributes/*.json (links: attribute key, isRequired). SOURCE.md records the source for NFR-LEG-002.

nodes.label: load-categories
nodes.desc: Program.cs branch: same host and DI, runs migrations, resolves LoadCategoryTreeHandler, prints the report with LoadReportPrinter, exits 0 (applied or unchanged), 2 (refused) or 1 (failure). No Kestrel, no outbox relay.

nodes.label: Load handler
nodes.desc: LoadCategoryTreeHandler: read source → CategoryTreeSource.Build → begin transaction + pg_advisory_xact_lock → load current tree and categories with products (ICategoryUsage, empty until FEAT-012) → diff → rollback or apply + version + outbox → commit.

nodes.label: CategoryTreeDiff
nodes.desc: Pure domain: NameCleaner (BR-014-11), file-integrity problems, BR-014-6/7 add/rename/loosen versus refuse, leaf flags and positions. Returns every problem or a change set with counts.

nodes.label: Read endpoints
nodes.desc: ListCategoriesHandler (roots or one parent's children, ordered by position; skeleton probe kept) and GetCategoryHandler (path, and attributes only for a leaf). Names as {vi, en}; blank en falls back to vi (FR-LOC-008).

nodes.label: Category tables
nodes.desc: categories, attributes, attribute_values keyed by the Tiki integer ids (D-9), category_attributes (ordered ValueIds int[]).

nodes.label: outbox
nodes.desc: The CategoryTreeChanged row is staged with IEventOutbox.Stage and commits with the load (ADR-0002). The running Catalog service's relay sends it.

nodes.label: Service Bus
nodes.desc: Topic per event family, subscription per consumer (ADR-0002).

nodes.label: Search-AI
nodes.desc: Later feature: subscribes to CategoryTreeChanged, pulls the tree over a Catalog read path it designs (gRPC), and also on first start.

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.desc: Any visitor; the category endpoints are public.

nodes.label: Storefront SPA
nodes.desc: features/catalog/api.ts fetchCategories() reads the roots; CategoryBar.vue shows name.en or name.vi for the active language. Only the type changes (no slug). Stays text-only here; FEAT-018 shows the top-level images and the placeholder for imageUrl: null (D-10).

nodes.label: Seller centre
nodes.desc: Later feature: the category picker on SCR-SEL-004 walks the tree level by level and reads a leaf's attributes to build the form.

nodes.label: Gateway
nodes.desc: Existing route catalog-categories (/v1/categories/{**rest}, policy anonymous) covers both endpoints. No change.

all.title: FEAT-014 design solution
all.intro: Load the tree (applied, refused, unchanged) and read it one level at a time.

applied.title: Load the tree: applied (UC-020 main 1–2, alt 1a)

steps.t: Start the manual resource; it runs load-categories --source data/category-tree after Catalog's migrations.
Read and clean the files (NFC, control characters, trim); file-integrity problems are collected.
Lock and read: transaction, advisory lock, current tree and categories with products.
Diff: only adds, renames, loosenings and reorders → a change set with counts.
Relay: the running Catalog sends the event to Service Bus; the report prints APPLIED with counts, exit 0.
Read: missing vi/en names, duplicate keys, unknown parents and duplicate values are collected, not thrown.
Diff against the current tree: removed or moved category, removed attribute or value, tightened attribute, child or required attribute on a category with products.
Rollback: nothing written, no outbox row; the report lists every problem with its code, exit 2.

unchanged.title: Load the same file again (UC-020 alt 1a)

steps.t: Diff is empty: every item compares equal.
Rollback: nothing written, no event; report UNCHANGED with every count in "unchanged", exit 0.
Query by ParentId ordered by Position; names returned as {vi, en}. Top-level categories also carry imageUrl (or null for the placeholder).
Children: ?parentId={id}; a leaf returns []; unknown id → 404 common.not_found.

Leaf detail: GET /v1/categories/{id} → path and the leaf's effective attributes (its own, else its nearest ancestor's; D-12): required, list or text, single or up to max, allowsCustomValue, values in file order.

notes.b: User decision 2026-11-25 on ADR-0018's open Catalog store: relational tree, one transaction with the outbox, FEAT-012 checks in SQL.

Kind, selection, maximum, AllowsCustomValue and value order sit on attributes / attribute_values; a link keeps only position and required. Migration SharedAttributeLists reshapes and empties the tree tables. Supersedes D-2.
Catalog owns the loader; the dashboard starts it and shows the report. Diverges from dev-standards §2 (seeds in tools/).
~6,100 categories are too big for one payload; {vi, en} keeps the client-picks convention and CategoryBar working.

notes.t: Leaves inherit from the nearest ancestor
notes.b: A leaf with no links uses its nearest ancestor's (FR-CAT-023). EffectiveAttributes serves getCategory, the load checks (attribute.inherited_dropped, required via inheritance) and FEAT-012. Supersedes D-5.
CategoryTreeChanged carries only changedAt; consumers read the current tree, so no version or category_tree table is needed.
Product create takes pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared and implements ICategoryUsage; until then AC-014-2.5, 2.7 and 2.8 are proved with a fake usage set.
Breaking change to the skeleton contract, its feature file, client and MigrationTests, all updated here.
Category, attribute and value ids are the integer keys from the file, so every row maps back to Tiki. Exception to ADR-0009 (UUID v7) for this reference data; products keep UUIDs.
Top-level categories carry the file's imageUrl; null means the client shows the placeholder. A reload may add, change or remove an image. A failed image must not break the page (FEAT-018).
A subscription created after the first load misses that event; FEAT-018 reads the tree on start.
Record Catalog = PostgreSQL in ADR-0018 (architecture owner).
Tasks use fixtures; the committed data lands when the owner's file with en names and trimmed lists arrives. Large value lists (up to 1,000) would bloat getCategory.

notes.t: UC-020 exception flow and repo layout
notes.b: Suggest UC-020 2a (refused load) and adding data/ to repo-structure.md.
Record that platform reference data from the category file keeps its integer source keys.
allowsCustomValue false → true is a loosening; true → false is attribute.tightened. Typed-text rules belong to FEAT-012 (BR-012-7).
Open lists of up to 1,000 values can make getCategory a few hundred KB; re-measure TAC-014-5/6 on the owner's v2 file.

sections.title: Load problems (whole load refused)
sections.lead: Each problem is printed with its code, kind, key and owner. All are listed, not only the first (AC-014-1.4).
rows: vi or en absent or blank after cleaning; over 200 (300 for values)
a key that is not a whole number in the int range (ids are the Tiki keys)
a top-level imageUrl that is not an absolute https URL of at most 500 characters
duplicate keys, a link to an unknown attribute (attributes.unknown), invalid selection, duplicate value names (BR-014-11)
a stored category absent or under another parent
a stored link, attribute definition or list value absent
optional → required, multiple → single, lower max, list ↔ text, accepts other values → does not
changes to a leaf with products, including through the attributes it inherits (FR-CAT-023)
